description: Run on every transaction before you sign it. Shows what each wallet gains and loses, blocks drainer tricks, and catches failures and expired blockhashes before you pay a fee. Decodes every step, dry-runs the transaction on live mainnet, works out each wallet's SOL and token changes, and answers OK, REVIEW or BLOCK with the reasons. Inputs: tx: The transaction, base64-encoded. Signed or not. Legacy and v0 both work. network (optional): Which Solana network to read. Default "mainnet-beta" (real money). Cost: 25 free calls a day, then $0.02 USDC per call (x402). Full field-by-field docs: GET /api/tools/check_tx.

network.description: Which Solana network to read. Default "mainnet-beta" (real money). Leave it out for mainnet. Use "devnet" only for test wallets.

tx.description: The transaction, base64-encoded. Signed or not. Legacy and v0 both work. From your wallet SDK before signing: Buffer.from(tx.serialize({ requireAllSignatures: false })).toString('base64'). Or the swap transaction an aggregator API gave you.

name: check_tx
